evals.prompt: nel repo acme (Next.js, apps/web) aggiungi la schermata /preparazione/[slug]: la home del pacchetto di preparazione per un concorso, con giorni alla prova, percentuale di preparazione, piano di oggi e i moduli (quiz, situazionali, simulazione, tutor). Fammi vedere prima come la imposteresti: passi, skill che useresti, controlli finali. Non scrivere codice.
evals.expected_output: Task type B led by impeccable: context on the project stylesheet, extend the existing surface with project tokens, no taste draw, keeps the DESIGN.md stamps (uppercase Schibsted 800; Courier only for data), done-check with inspector/detect/critique/audit/guidelines/verify.

assertions.name: lead-is-impeccable
assertions.text: The plan makes impeccable the lead skill for this app screen

assertions.name: no-new-palette-or-type
assertions.text: The plan does not draw a new palette or type (no taste draw.mjs direction, or explicitly --keep palette,type) and builds with the project's tokens

assertions.name: keeps-stamp-labels
assertions.text: The plan follows the project's DESIGN.md for stamps (uppercase Schibsted 800 stamps kept; Courier Prime only for data), and says taste's micro-label rule must not override the stamps

assertions.name: telemetry-off
assertions.text: The plan runs impeccable with telemetry disabled (IMPECCABLE_NO_TELEMETRY=1 / DO_NOT_TRACK=1)

assertions.name: measures-mobile-and-desktop
assertions.text: The done-check includes screenshots or inspection at phone width (about 390) and desktop width (about 1440)

assertions.name: accessibility-audit
assertions.text: The done-check includes an accessibility audit (impeccable audit or equivalent)

assertions.name: project-verify
assertions.text: The done-check runs the project's own checks (kit verify, lint/tests/build or Playwright flows)

evals.prompt: mi serve una landing page per lanciare un nuovo prodotto di corsi di ceramica, progetto nuovo senza nessun design system. Prima di scrivere codice dimmi il piano: quali skill usi, in che ordine, e come verifichi che sia bella e accessibile.
evals.expected_output: Task type A: impeccable context/init, taste steps for direction (draw options), DESIGN.md committed via impeccable new-work, build after craft floor, done-check with taste inspector plus impeccable critique and audit and guidelines.

assertions.name: taste-for-direction
assertions.text: The plan uses taste for art direction of the page (e.g. draw.mjs options / directions)

assertions.name: impeccable-for-product-context
assertions.text: The plan uses impeccable for product context or the design system (context/init/PRODUCT.md or DESIGN.md)

assertions.name: writes-design-system
assertions.text: The plan records the chosen direction as a design system file (DESIGN.md or tokens) before or while building

assertions.name: telemetry-off
assertions.text: The plan runs impeccable with telemetry disabled (IMPECCABLE_NO_TELEMETRY=1 / DO_NOT_TRACK=1)

assertions.name: measures-mobile-and-desktop
assertions.text: The done-check includes screenshots or inspection at phone width (about 390) and desktop width (about 1440)

assertions.name: accessibility-audit
assertions.text: The done-check includes an accessibility audit (impeccable audit or equivalent)

assertions.name: bounded-fix-loop
assertions.text: The plan bounds the fix loop (e.g. one batched fix round then re-check, or a stated maximum) instead of open-ended iteration

evals.prompt: la home di acme sembra generica e fatta con l'AI, rendila migliore. Dimmi solo il piano: cosa controlli, quali skill, cosa cambieresti per primo e cosa NON tocchi.
evals.expected_output: Task type C led by impeccable: critique then audit, fixes via named commands, taste before/after inspection only as a meter, keeps the existing brand and stamp labels, report with precedence calls.

assertions.name: critique-and-audit-first
assertions.text: The plan starts with an impeccable critique and/or audit of the existing home before changing anything

assertions.name: keeps-brand
assertions.text: The plan states it does not replace the existing palette and fonts (the project's tokens, Schibsted Grotesk / Atkinson / Courier Prime)

assertions.name: keeps-stamp-labels
assertions.text: The plan follows the project's DESIGN.md for stamps (uppercase Schibsted 800 stamps kept; Courier Prime only for data), and says taste's micro-label rule must not override the stamps

assertions.name: taste-only-as-meter
assertions.text: Taste is used, if at all, as a measuring/inspection tool or source of ideas, not to redraw the direction

assertions.name: telemetry-off
assertions.text: The plan runs impeccable with telemetry disabled (IMPECCABLE_NO_TELEMETRY=1 / DO_NOT_TRACK=1)

assertions.name: before-after-evidence
assertions.text: The plan produces before/after evidence (screenshots or scores) to show the home actually improved
